title: Three Kids on Oceanfront Seawall, 1956 California Coast B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot capturing three siblings or friends resting against a concrete coastal seawall on a sunny day in August 1956. The girl on the right wears high-waisted white shorts with bows and a sleeveless patterned top, while the two younger boys wear 1950s casual wear, including cuffed jeans and a horizontal striped t-shirt. Behind them lies a scenic rocky coastline and ocean surf, typical of the Southern California coast (such as La Jolla). The top front border is machine-stamped 'AUG • 56'.
